expectations.text: Explains the commodity problem and selling in a 'category of one' (value-driven, not price-driven)
Applies the Value Equation: dream outcome x perceived likelihood divided by time delay x effort/sacrifice
Walks through the five steps: dream outcome, list problems, solutions, delivery vehicles, trim and stack
Uses delivery 'cheat codes' such as one-on-one vs group vs one-to-many, DIY/DWY/DFY, or the 10x / 1/10th test
Recommends charging a premium (virtuous cycle of price) and/or niching to a specific avatar
Adds enhancers (bonuses, guarantee, scarcity/urgency, or naming) to the offer
